attributes.name: Witch Doctor
attributes.powers:
Each time a character plays a spell, the difficulty of the check to defeat is increased by 2. 

If defeated, you may banish a barrier with the Curse trait displayed in front of a character at your location, and you may immediately attempt to close the location this henchman came from.
